title: Notice Charge on a Stay Cancelled in Progress — Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Notice charge on a stay cancelled in progress — guest payment reference

## Policy statement

When a guest cancels a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that is already in progress, the guest owes the nights the cancellation keeps that the stay's collections have not paid, and Roamhaven collects them from the guest in one notice charge on the cancelled stay. This covers a guest who leaves a long stay paid month by month before the installments reach the nights the cancellation keeps, and a guest who checked in while the collection of installment 1 was still declined and leaves before paying it.

Money is collected only on a confirmed or checked-in stay, except that a notice charge is collected on a stay already cancelled by the guest.

For each component the refund posted is the lesser of the amount of that component collected so far and the amount refundable under this rule, except that on a cancellation dated on or after the check-in date the nightly amounts collected pay for the stay's nights in date order and the nightly refund is the nightly amount collected less the price of the nights the cancellation keeps, never below 0.00.

A notice charge, like every installment, carries the guest service fee and occupancy tax attributable to the amounts it collects.

The notice charge is booked as the installment that covers the first unpaid night the cancellation keeps; when no installment has been collected on the stay, that is installment 1.

The notice charge is not collected until the stay's ledger carries the guest-cancellation refund owed on the stay's pet fee. The notice charge is not collected until the stay's ledger carries the guest-cancellation refund owed on the stay's extra-guest fee. The notice charge is not collected until the stay's ledger carries the guest-cancellation refund owed on Roamhaven's guest service fee.

Read against the stay's ledger: until it shows the guest-cancellation refund owed on the pet fee, the guest-cancellation refund owed on the extra-guest fee and the guest-cancellation refund owed on Roamhaven's guest service fee, the notice charge is not collected.

## Paying the notice charge — `pay_notice_charge_caff8891`

**Situation of use and capability.** The guest pays, from their own payment method, the notice charge owed on a stay they cancelled while it was in progress. One call records one collection on that stay's money ledger for the amount given, filed under the installment number given; the amount then shows as collected on the stay and the guest sees the payment on their reservation.

**How it is invoked.** `pay_notice_charge_caff8891` is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, paying from their own payment method.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `stay_id` | the reference number of the cancelled stay (reservation) the guest is paying the notice charge on, as returned by the stay lookup for that guest | identifier |
| `installment_number` | the installment the notice charge is filed under: the number of the installment that covers the first unpaid night the cancellation keeps (1 when no installment was ever collected on the stay) | a non-negative whole number, no decimals |
| `amount` | the notice charge the guest pays | a positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places; a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places when booked |

**Return.** A receipt listing `collection_reference` (the reference number of the new collection record), `stay_id` (the stay paid on), `installment_number` (the installment the collection is filed under), `amount` (US dollars with 2 decimal places, the amount collected), `posted_at` (the moment the collection was recorded, in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) and a status, which is always "collected" when the payment went through.
